Solution B is correct. The SUV would use 12,000 / 15 = 800 gallons and the hybrid 12,000 / 48 = 250 gallons, so Karla would have saved 800 − 250 = 550 gallons.

Solution A misapplies the distance = rate × time formula, treating miles per gallon as if it were miles per hour. That leads to a meaningless "gallons per hour" calculation and a false answer of 0.

WINNER: B
